svg.title: Speedup over each project's own baseline

svg.text: Speedup over each project's own baseline
21 projects · 7 research domains · higher is faster
* Hatched: extrapolated estimate · LLM2Vec: SimCSE stage (MNTP 1.29×) · details in docs/results
PIDG: module group including PNG output; not complete-training time.
